description_fill_in: Unique sequential identifier of each transaction (1 to 5,000). Identifier only; excluded from model inputs.
Date and time the transaction occurred, in chronological order. Used to derive hour, day of week and time-since-last-transaction features.
Masked card identifier (format CARD_XXXX + last 4 digits). No real card number is stored; used to group a card's transactions for behaviour features.
Transaction amount in currency units. Strongly right-skewed (median about 92, maximum about 4,242 in the original data); log-transformed before modelling.
Type of merchant: Fuel, Travel, Electronics, Online, Healthcare, Grocery, Restaurant. One-hot encoded for modelling.
Target label: 1 = fraudulent transaction, 0 = legitimate. Used only to train supervised models and to evaluate all models, never as an input feature.
Identifier of the merchant (MER0001 to MER0500). Identifier only; excluded from model inputs to avoid memorising merchants.
Type of card used: Credit, Debit or Prepaid. One-hot encoded; also used as a group for the fairness analysis of false positives.
